question: does a section of the bus wire under the liner's mouth or exit edge out-rank the welded root once the contact pressure carried through the PEEK layer is added to the nominal bending — on 86's Soderberg line?

inputs.geometry: shipped — the whole lock shank (HW.26 G1)
inputs.convention: 86: 1/SF = σ_a/(k·σ_e) + σ_m⁺/σ_y; the root carries k, a section under an edge is drawn wire

not_solved.reason: a contact patch outgrew every window (or the rod lies along the wall between them) — a line contact two end windows cannot represent; refusing

summary.text: «bonded»: inside ⌀0.10 the welded root stays the critical section for every seam knock-down k < 0.97 (lowest at the mouth plus face, 40 µm: drawn-wire SF 60.8, contact ×1.00 on 1/SF — nominal bending, the mouth section out-swinging the root as in 92; root SF 36.5 at k = 1 at 50 µm), beyond it the lowest is 6.72 (mouth plus, 75 µm); the liner end's unmodelled corner stays below every modelled section while it concentrates its bare-side nominal by less than ×1.74 (k 0.388, 40 µm) / ×1.05 (k 1, 35 µm) — of the order of the liner's own stiffening of the wire (×1.067), so not bounded here — 1 path point(s) refused by 92 (at 30 µm, drag -0.0117 N of ±0.500 N): that cycle omits them, so its root and station amplitudes are both lower bounds and the k_x there has no known direction; «frictionless»: inside ⌀0.10 the welded root stays the critical section for every seam knock-down k < 0.66 (lowest at the exit plus face, 35 µm: drawn-wire SF 62.8, contact ×3.03 on 1/SF — the contact's swing about a compressive mean, counted by 86's line; with the arc ceiling's ×1.3 on the contact's share it would be 0.43–0.49, so an estimate, not a bound; root SF 36.5 at k = 1 at 50 µm), beyond it the lowest is 6.76 (mouth plus, 75 µm); the liner end's unmodelled corner stays below every modelled section while it concentrates its bare-side nominal by less than ×1.74 (k 0.388, 40 µm) / ×1.19 (k 1, 50 µm) — of the order of the liner's own stiffening of the wire (×1.067), so not bounded here. The largest tension the contact through the layer puts on the wire, pointwise: bonded +0.001 MPa (40 µm, exit plus) · frictionless +0.550 MPa (100 µm, mouth minus); its weight on a station's worst 1/SF is largest (×3.66, frictionless 100 µm exit plus) where the governing cycle's mean is compressive — 86's line counting a compressive swing as amplitude without crediting the mean, the conservative reading; where the governing cycle's mean is tensile it raises the station's worst 1/SF by at most ×1.07 (frictionless, 30 µm, mouth minus, SF 100.7).
